label: Diagram D1
caption: Diagram D1 | Measurement of door width | D Building dimensions
description:
The drawing is a diagram titled "Diagram D1 Measurement of door width". It contains two plan views, one on the left and one on the right, each showing a door set in an opening between two walls, drawn in grey with jagged cut ends. In each view the door leaf is shown swung open, with a curved arc marking the swing path, and a hinge symbol on the leaf. A dashed vertical line indicates the closed position of the door.

In the left view, a green dimension line with end ticks lies across the opening, labelled "Effective clear width (door stop to projecting ironmongery)"; the measurement runs from the door stop at the left hand jamb to the projecting ironmongery on the open leaf.

In the right view, a similar green dimension line is labelled "Effective clear width (door stop to door leaf)", the measurement running from the door stop to the edge of the door leaf. A green footer band along the bottom contains the title text "Diagram D1 Measurement of door width".
